description: Defines an abstract base class for entity translation renderers within Drupal's Views module, including methods for retrieving language codes, pre-render processing, rendering entities, and managing entity relationships.

classes.name: EntityTranslationRendererBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for rendering translated entities in Drupal Views.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Abstract method to get the language code for a given result row.

methods.name: getLangcodeByRelationship
methods.description: Returns the language code for a row, optionally considering a relationship.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Placeholder for query modification, inherited from interface.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares rendering by calling preRenderByRelationship with default 'none'.

methods.name: preRenderByRelationship
methods.description: Prepares entities for rendering based on a specified relationship.

methods.name: renderByRelationship
methods.description: Renders entity data for a row based on a relationship.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the entity associated with a result row, considering relationships.
